svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware ◆ Web host Squarespace lays off 19% of its employees ◆ New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping ◆ Snap settles lawsuit accusing platform of fueling teen depression and eating disorders ◆ In one of the largest deals in tech history, Marvell buys Lumentum for $115B ◆ Readwise takes on Amazon’s Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers ◆
